_provenance.what_this_is: the ITER-60 checkpoint of the 189-iteration run, not its final weight
_provenance.why: val loss bottoms at iter 60 (1.388) and climbs to 1.590 by 189
_provenance.correction: This file was COPIED from the full run and said iters:189 with adapter_path pointing at the e3 directory — it described the run, not the checkpoint the directory holds. Anyone reading it would have concluded these weights were the final ones. Corrected 2026-09-15; the generations already produced are unaffected, because mlx-lm reads lora_parameters and num_layers at load time (identical in both) and never reads iters.
